'''Gorneesh''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] of a tribe of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His wife was named [[Urgah]], and he had three children, including [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Boogutt]]. Gorneesh and his Duloks were the sworn enemies of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Joe [Johnston] killed off their leader, so rather than try to revive him when I did the Ewok development, I created three new Duloks and made them the leaders.|[[Paul Dini]]|<ref name="Starlog">{{Starlog|Yearbook 3|Saturday Morning "Star Wars"}}</ref>}}
King Gorneesh appeared in the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], where he was voiced by [[Dan Hennessey]] in the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]].
